title: Independent bounded Swedish remaining-P1 linguistic review
review_method: Independent model-based review of every complete English and Swedish message, production call sites and surrounding operation context; structural parity checked separately. No application source was edited by this reviewer.

coverage.scope: Exactly the 149 missing Swedish P1 string identities at source_sha; no pre-existing Swedish entry or other tier reviewed anew.

checks.exact_missing_key_set: pass: 149/149, no additions from other tiers or existing Swedish keys
checks.placeholder_token_multiset: pass: 149/149, including positional indexes, types, precision and grouping flag

revisions_reviewed.result: Final two-finger wording independently re-read and accepted with source-only limit.
An earlier TSV used Base64-kodad bildtext. The author and reviewer independently identified its caption ambiguity. Final bilddata som Base64-text is accepted.
Final pekgester wording independently re-read and accepted with source-only limit.

limits: Independent AI/model-based bounded linguistic review; not native-speaker acceptance.
No whole-Swedish or whole-language acceptance; pre-existing uncertainty and withdrawn historical conclusions remain unchanged.
No device rendering, layout, TalkBack execution, Android build or runtime test was performed by this reviewer.
Fifteen resources have no current direct production reference. Fourteen receive source-semantic acceptance only; the third-placeholder palette resource is withheld.
No plural resource occurs in this P1 batch; this review makes no claim about Swedish plural coverage in other tiers.
The 148 accepted values close only 148 exact direct-presence gaps if integrated; one P1 gap remains. Presence does not certify broader language completeness.
